Exit gates (examples)
- Critical data leak or PII exposure discovered during eval
- Sustained performance regression (latency or error rate) that we can’t remediate within the test window
- Missed milestones that block meaningful evaluation for >3 business days

Post-eval deprovision options (defaults in MAP)
- Default: Redwood deprovisions the evaluation instance and purges test data after 30 days unless otherwise requested by MediQ.
- Option A: Extended retention (90 days) — requires written approval and additional retention addendum (we’ll capture in the MAP).

Looping in the specifics that will be executed during the acceptance window. Quick bullets + measurable thresholds: 

Acceptance test categories (samples)
- Functional correctness: top-1 intent accuracy > 95% on the curated evaluation set (listed in MAP sheet "eval_set"). Manual spot checks for high-risk intents.
- Concordance / hallucination rate: false-positive hallucination incidents < 2% on the sample prompts
- Performance: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms for typical 256-token requests; throughput benchmarks for batch workloads will be included in the test harness.
- Stability: <0.5% request error rate and <1% degraded-response rate over 24h rolling windows.
- Security/compliance checkpoints: all required artifacts (config snapshots, audit logs) handed to MediQ security within 48 hours of request.

Rollout & canary proposal
- Canary day: 2027-12-14 — 10% of test traffic (validation only)
- Scale window: 2027-12-15—12/18 — ramp to full eval traffic
- Signoff window: 2027-12-19—12/21 — capture results and customer signoff

Deprovision language suggestion (contract-friendly)
- Redwood default: deprovision and destroy evaluation environment + test data 30 days after signoff.
- Customer may request extended retention (90 days) with a signed retention addendum and acceptance of minimal hosting fees.

Action items for MediQ: please confirm (1) owners (Samira for security reviews), (2) decision on 30 vs 90 day retention, (3) access to the sample eval dataset (S3 link or secure FTP).
